data.one_liner: Dart JS-interop wrapper for Google Identity Services Web SDK
data.what_it_does: Provides Dart bindings to Google’s Sign‑In‑With‑Google and OAuth2 JavaScript APIs, allowing Flutter Web apps to load the SDK and call its functions from Dart code.
use_when: Implement Google Sign‑In on a Flutter Web app
Need to call Google OAuth2 flows from a web page
avoid_when: Building a mobile or desktop app
strengths: Pure Dart wrapper, no native code
Handles loading the SDK via script tag or on‑demand
No need for allowInterop in callbacks
Supports both authentication and authorization APIs
weaknesses: Web‑only, not usable on mobile or desktop
Requires manual script tag or conditional import
Limited to Google Identity Services, no other providers
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec, optionally insert <script src="https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client" async defer></script> in index.html or call loadWebSdk() in main.dart
